en.t: This poem is based on Japanese mythology:

units.source_text: 伊奘诺、伊奘冉，是日本创造天地的夫妇二神。

en.t: Izanagi and Izanami are the two married deities who created heaven and earth in Japanese myth.

units.source_text: 所生第一子名叫“蛭子”，长到三岁，

en.t: Their first child was named Hiruko, and by the time he reached the age of three,
both of his legs were paralyzed, and he could not stand up.

units.source_text: 故“倏经蛭子跛瘫年”，即“倏经三年”之意。

en.t: Therefore, the phrase "swiftly passing through Hiruko's crippled and paralyzed years" means "swiftly passing through three years."

units.source_text: 蛭子曾乘苇船泛海，故源氏以此自比。

en.t: Hiruko once drifted across the sea in a reed boat, so Genji compares himself to him in this way.

units.source_text: 又，此夫妇二神在天上时本是兄妹，后来下凡，

en.t: Also, when these two married deities were in heaven, they were originally brother and sister, and later they descended to earth.

units.source_text: 在一岛上绕柱相会，互相求爱，遂成为夫妇。

en.t: On an island, they circled around a pillar, met one another, courted each other, and thus became husband and wife.
The following poem refers to this story.
